description: Fork of exp606 (vanilla MinimalGPT + LUT FFN = 1.4736 @ 167M). Single change: backward_mode soft -> hybrid_smooth (default n_alt=1, manual path, dense K-row input grad via _soft_lut_bwd_body). Forward becomes 2-row smooth blend instead of K=64-row soft blend; backward keeps dense K-row attribution. Tests whether the sharp-forward + dense-backward hybrid (exp611 style) helps vanilla+LUT-FFN architecture too. Reference: exp328 vanilla = 1.3882, exp606 baseline = 1.4736.
